inputClaimId.title: inputClaimId
inputClaimId.description: Unique identifier of the claim to be analyzed. Ask the user to provide the Claim ID if available; otherwise this can be left blank and the system may resolve the latest relevant claim automatically.

inputClaimName.title: inputClaimName
inputClaimName.description: Name or reference of a known claim associated with the selected part and vehicle model. If no claim name is provided, the system will use the most recent relevant claim from the queue.
